panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic book cover inside a dark stone vault. Exactly four 11-year-old kids stand in a row at the bottom, smiling up, left to right: a light-skinned girl with a black bun in a crimson jacket; a dark-skinned boy in a royal blue hoodie; a brown boy with spiky hair in a burnt orange t-shirt; a tan girl with a brown bun in an emerald green sweatshirt. Behind them two tall arched dark blue stone doors side by side with gold trim. Above the doors grins a scribbly teal chalk-cloud creature with yellow eyes. Upper right floats a small teal hexagon robot orb with one golden eye. Top quarter plain dark stone.
